_notes: Pair: chain A is Sepolia (11155111), chain B is PulseChain testnet v4 (943). Built from script/hardened/bridge.config.example.json on 2026-10-26.
Values for genesis, clock and fork data were read from the beacon endpoints of one.valve.city (genesis, config/spec, config/fork_schedule: all HTTP 200).

Checkpoint fields (initialSlot, initialHeaderRoot, initialSyncCommitteeHash, initialNextSyncCommitteeHash of all three checkpoints) are still placeholders. Print them with `zk-bridge-prover checkpoint` at one finalized root of the same chain (all four from the same root). Public keyless beacon endpoints: https://lodestar-sepolia.chainsafe.io (Sepolia) and https://rpc-testnet-pulsechain.g4mm4.io/beacon-api (chain 943; it has no light_client routes, the command then uses the finalized debug state).

Program keys: rebuilt on 2026-10-27 so that the programs take every layout from the evidence and read no fork table (light-client/program-keys.json, docs/sp1-version-policy.md). Two Docker builds gave identical keys. These values replace the old keys of every chain.

Gloas: Sepolia is on fork version 0x90000076 (Gloas) from epoch 353024. The gate lists it with stateDepth 255 (the marker of a progressive state: the version leaf sits at index 169), and the seal depths add 255 so that the next fork can seal the gate. The bridge takes no Gloas epoch (the key gloasForkEpoch is refused since 2026-11-10): each message proof carries the fork proof of its source state, and a progressive (Gloas) source takes the bid parent hash rule while a plain one takes the body layout. The light client follows the Gloas head through state.latest_block_hash. See docs/testnet-run.md.

943 wrapped native token: 0x70499adEBB11Efd915E3b69E700c331778628707 (WPLS, Wrapped Pulse, 18 decimals). Checked on 2026-10-26 with eth_getCode (deposit and withdraw selectors present), symbol(), name(), decimals() and totalSupply() equal to the contract balance. The address was not found in a project document: confirm it once more before you rely on it for value.
Multicall3 0xcA11bde05977b3631167028862bE2a173976CA11 has code on both chains (eth_getCode, 2026-10-26): same runtime code, 3808 bytes.
Foundry resolves rpcAlias from the environment: FOUNDRY_RPC_ENDPOINTS='{sepolia="<url>",pulsechain_testnet_v4="<url>"}'. See docs/testnet-run.md. Never write the key into this file.
